title: Phantom Blade Zero Release Date - Out Now on PS5 and PC
description: Phantom Blade Zero released on October 29, 2026 for PS5 and PC and is out now. Launch sales, the Steam peak, the first patch, and why some pages still list September 9.
keyword: phantom blade zero release date, when does phantom blade zero come out, is phantom blade zero out, phantom blade zero release

sections.title: The Short Answer: It Is Out Now
sections.content:
Phantom Blade Zero released on October 29, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Windows PC through Steam and the Epic Games Store. There is no countdown left to wait for: the digital game is on sale, it has been patched once, and the disc version is the only thing still in the future.

Unlock time was 02:00 UTC on 29 October. That lands on the evening of 28 October in the United States, which is why some pages still say the 28th. Both dates are correct for their region and the game has been live on both since.

If you are here to decide whether to buy, the practical questions are price, platform and length. The buying guide covers editions and what is actually on sale now, the platform page covers Xbox and Switch 2, and how long to beat covers playtime.

sections.title: What Happened After Launch
sections.content:
These are the numbers S-GAME and the storefronts published in the first fortnight, rather than pre-release estimates:

DateWhat was publishedSource
October 28-29, 2026Digital launch, PS5 and PC. Unlock at 02:00 UTC, which is the evening of 28 October in the US.S-GAME / store listings
November 1, 2026Steam concurrent peak of 833,921 players, the highest point of launch weekend.SteamPeaks
November 2, 2026Four million copies sold across all platforms in the first 72 hours.S-GAME (@pbzero_official)
November 4, 2026First post-launch patch, version 1.0302256.Steam news / S-GAME

Two cautions on those figures. Four million is a combined digital total; S-GAME has not split it by platform. Third-party estimates put the split at roughly 3.1 million on Steam and 1.2 million on PlayStation by 3 November, but that is a model built from store signals rather than studio data, and it excludes Epic. Concurrent players are PC only, so 833,921 is not a sales number either.

sections.title: The First Patch Arrived on November 4
sections.content: Version 1.0302256 is the first post-launch update. It is mostly quality-of-life work rather than a balance overhaul: one boss made less punishing on the two lower difficulties, faster PC start-up, new audio sliders, and fixes for progression blockers. The full breakdown, including the shader change that will make your first PC launch after updating look slow, is on the patch notes page.

sections.title: Why You Still See September 9, 2026
sections.content:
September 9 was the original date, announced on stage at The Game Awards in December 2025. The 9/9 symbolism was deliberate: it mirrors the 66-day premise of the story. In June 2026 S-GAME moved the release to October 29 to allow more development time.

Any page still presenting September 9 as the date has not been updated since that June announcement. There was only ever one delay, and there has been no second delay and no further movement since.

sections.title: The Disc Version Is 2027, Not Now
sections.content:
On 22 October, alongside the launch trailer, S-GAME said the physical PlayStation 5 edition arrives in 2027. There is still no month, no price and no note on disc layout or whether the build is on the disc or downloaded. Everything on sale today is digital.

Details on what the boxed version is expected to contain, and what to do if you specifically want a disc, are on the physical edition page.

sections.title: Release Date Questions
sections.content:
When does Phantom Blade Zero come out?

It came out on October 29, 2026 and is available now on PS5 and PC.

Is Phantom Blade Zero out yet?

Yes. The digital release went live at 02:00 UTC on 29 October 2026, with the first patch following on 4 November.

Was Phantom Blade Zero delayed?

Once. It moved from September 9, 2026 to October 29, 2026 in June 2026, and has not moved since.

Is there a physical version at launch?

No. Launch was digital only; the boxed PS5 edition is a 2027 release with no date yet.
